output.content: I walked through the deployment workflow this morning to verify the current validation sequence. The risk assessment happens entirely by hand. I watched the team pull logs from the last three production runs, copy the relevant metrics into a shared spreadsheet, and compare them against the baseline thresholds. There is no automated check that triggers a block if the variance exceeds the limit. The engineer manually reviews the output and types a confirmation flag into the ticket before the model is allowed to proceed to the next phase. This manual review takes about forty minutes per release. I noted the timestamps on the ticket to confirm the duration. The process relies on human attention to catch any anomalies in the data drift patterns.
